title: Sloth dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- limbs, dancing pose -->
  <g stroke-linecap='round'>
    <!-- left arm raised -->
    <path d='M38 52 L20 34' stroke='#6b4f2a' stroke-width='7' fill='none'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='32' r='5' fill='#8a6b3d'/>
    <!-- right arm out -->
    <path d='M62 52 L82 46' stroke='#6b4f2a' stroke-width='7' fill='none'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='45' r='5' fill='#8a6b3d'/>
    <!-- legs dancing -->
    <path d='M44 80 L34 94' stroke='#6b4f2a' stroke-width='7' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M58 80 L70 92' stroke='#6b4f2a' stroke-width='7' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet paws -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='95' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a6b3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='93' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a6b3d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#a8824e'/>
  <!-- belly patch lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#d9b87e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#b8945c'/>
  <!-- face mask lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#e6cfa0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='36' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5a3d1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='36' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5a3d1e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#4a3018'/>
  <!-- smile, upside down sleepy grin -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 51 56 47' stroke='#4a3018' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little music notes / motion sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='60' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='64' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#7ee0ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#7ee0ff'/>
</svg>
